title: Red spider mite and broad mite on papaya

Header: Red spider mite and broad mite on papaya
Tetranychus spp , Polyphagotarsenemus latus Sinhala: Papol Rathu makulu mitawa; Tamil: Sivappu silanthi sittuni

Prevention: Maintain the vigour of trees by
Irrigating in dry period to regulate humidity and temperature
Avoid stress conditions, use recommended fertilizers and avoid overuse of nitrogen fertilizers
Maintain good sanitation (remove and burn infested crop residues immediately after harvest)
Avoid planting adjacent to infested fields
Monitoring: Avoid planting adjacent to infested fields
Observe underside of affected leaves for live red spider mites (tiny, red or yellow, moving insects)
Observe growing points for broad mites (use magnifying glass); downward curling and malformed buds
Tap leaf on white paper to see mites
Monitor of yellow spots on leaves
Direct Control: Neem seed extract at 400g in 10L water
Restrictions: Spray early morning or late evening to reduce injury to honey bees.
Spray to the underside of the leaves at early infestation stage.
Always wear personal protective equipment while handling pesticides.
Read the manufacturer’s instructions carefully before handling pesticides.
Do not eat, smoke or drink while spraying pesticides.
Do not repeat pesticides with same mode of action.
Rate of dilution - 80g /10 lit of water.
Rate of dilution - 6ml/10 lit of water.
Rate of dilution - 5 ml/10 lit. of water.
Toxic to predatory mites, flower bugs and parasitoids.
Moderately toxic to lacewings and hoverflies
